roster.role: Explorer — the 200-year-old birthday boy who never meant to say twice to a puppeteer
Strategist — a bald-faced liar with two heads and a doctorate in survival
Warrior — hunter with a Martian's patience and a grudge against the Ringworld's emptiness
The lucky passenger — four generations of lotteries distilled into one warm girl
Guide — an old machine under the shadow squares, keeper of the scrith and the purpose

world_facts: a ring one million miles wide, two million miles across, encircling a star
the floor is scrith — translucent material stronger than any hull the expedition knew
the ring spins at 770 miles per second; the shadow squares eclipse the sun on schedule
the meteor called the Fist of God waits in the ring's floor, aimed at the Arch
on the rim: a city of puppeteers, neatly parked, neatly sane, and one great ship of fools
